Build a game state from an explicit position

Source: R/game.R
dp_game_from_units.Rd

Convenience constructor used by the test suites and by the Shiny board editor: places the given units on the board and fills supply-centre ownership from the home centres unless sc_owner says otherwise.

Usage

dp_game_from_units(
  units,
  map = dp_map(),
  season = "Spring",
  year = 1901,
  phase = "movement",
  sc_owner = NULL,
  dislodged = NULL,
  contested = character(0),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

units

A tibble or data frame with columns power, type, loc.

map

A dp_map object.

season

"Spring", "Fall" or "Winter".

year

Integer year.

phase

"movement", "retreat" or "build".

sc_owner

Optional named character vector mapping supply centre to owning power. Defaults to home ownership.

dislodged

Optional tibble of dislodged units awaiting retreat, with columns power, type, loc, from and by_convoy.

contested

Provinces closed to retreats after a standoff.

call

Caller environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A validated dp_game object.

See also

Other setup: dp_adjacent(), dp_example_game(), dp_game, dp_home_centres(), dp_map(), dp_map-class, dp_new_game(), dp_provinces(), dp_unit(), dp_units(), is_dp_game(), is_dp_map()

Examples

pos <- data.frame(
  power = c("France", "Germany"),
  type = c("army", "army"),
  loc = c("par", "mun")
)
dp_game_from_units(pos)
#> <dp_game> Spring 1901 (movement phase)
#> Russia    4 centres   0 units
#> Austria   3 centres   0 units
#> England   3 centres   0 units
#> France    3 centres   1 unit 
#> Germany   3 centres   1 unit 
#> Italy     3 centres   0 units
#> Turkey    3 centres   0 units
